name: Curry Leaf Swirly Omelette
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, season with salt and whisk the turmeric in. Set aside for a couple of minutes.

Set a non-stick pan over medium heat with a drizzle of oil. Add in the curry leaves and leave until they stop crackling. Pour the eggs in and leave to set for 15 secs before giving it a scramble. Once the egg starts to set, leave it alone until its cooked through, then remove from the heat.
Slide the omelette onto the rice, serve with a blob of ketchup and splash the soy sauce over the top. Dig in.
